memories.summary: Cleared the black-rock hobgoblin den through night stealth kills and open combat. Killed the hobgoblin leader in single combat using speed, bear-bone knives, and hand axe. No clean hits taken after initial clips. Ate the hobgoblin's heart raw afterward.
memories.details: Den contained ~30+ goblins originally. Reduced to hobgoblin + 11 by morning, then eliminated the rest. Hobgoblin was head-and-shoulders taller, scrap-armored, armed with spiked club and cleaver. Fight ended with tendon cuts, neck stab, and axe to the skull.

memories.summary: Consumed the hobgoblin heart and underwent major transformation during feverish sleep in the den. Woke as an athletic hobgoblin variant: taller than a human male, long powerful limbs, defined dense muscle, sharper face, no tusks. All prior wolf-touched senses and bear-touched traits (density, tougher skin, claw-like nails, endurance) fully retained and integrated.
memories.details: Growing pains were sharp and bone-deep. New form is athletic rather than bulky. Genitalia proportional (11-inch thick cock, heavy balls). Elena has since seen and is adjusting to the change. Strength, speed, and reach significantly increased.

memories.summary: Returned to the house in the new form. Elena was shocked but did not flee. Subsequent days of caretaking after intense sex further deepened the intertwined dependence and closeness.
